routes.title: Civil domestic-violence request / San Diego procedure

jurisdiction.court: Superior Court of California, County of San Diego

routes.first_consequential_decision: Judicial decision on requested temporary protection
routes.scope_note: Selected statewide forms with a San Diego submission overlay. This is not a complete filing packet or a statewide performance finding. Conditional and local forms still require a separate inventory.

steps.title: Request and supporting material
steps.description: The published instructions permit supporting emails or texts with the initial request. Actual use and delivery to a reviewer have not been measured.

steps.title: Submit through a documented channel
steps.actor: Filer, approved provider, and court receiving staff
steps.description: The San Diego FAQ describes optional electronic filing and an in-person alternative. Receipt, clerk processing, and judicial consideration must retain distinct meanings.

steps.title: Temporary protection decision
steps.description: The local notice distinguishes same-court-day processing from next-court-day review. No actual review timestamps or legal compliance results are available.

steps.title: Written response and supporting material
steps.description: DV-120 and its instructions document a written response route, including supporting pictures or texts. This is one documented opportunity; the universal earliest response opportunity is not established here.

steps.title: Hearing and evidence consideration
steps.description: The hearing guidance describes statements and optional supporting material. The judge decides which documents may be considered.

steps.title: Review or correction route
steps.actor: Responsible role not yet mapped in this edition
steps.description: A complete post-decision challenge, modification, appeal, service, and correction pathway has not been source-mapped in this selected pilot.

channels.title: Material with the initial request
channels.description: Emails and texts may accompany the request. The submission rate and time to decision-maker availability remain unknown.

channels.title: Material with a written response
channels.description: The response guidance permits supporting pictures and texts. This record does not establish every possible response channel or its practical accessibility.

channels.title: Material and statements at a hearing
channels.description: Statements can be proof; additional exhibits and witnesses are optional. Sharing, admissibility, and recorded consideration are distinct questions.

review_clocks.label: Published cutoff: on or before 3 p.m.
review_clocks.description: Effective November 16, 2026, the San Diego notice assigns requests submitted on or before 3 p.m. to same-court-day processing, and later requests to next-court-day review. This applies to the stated in-person and approved-provider channels.
review_clocks.time_zone_basis: Engineering normalization of court local time
review_clocks.conditions: Court calendar, submission completeness, applicable exceptions, and actual event timestamps must be established before any deadline calculation.

cost_items.label: Court charge for this electronic request
cost_items.notes: The FAQ publishes no court e-filing charge for this request. This describes one charge, not the total burden.

cost_items.label: Possible electronic filing provider charge
cost_items.notes: A provider may charge. The amount and payment timing are not established here; electronic filing is optional.

cost_items.label: Preparation, travel, childcare, or lost work
cost_items.notes: Proposed measurement categories. No participant expenses or affordability have been observed.

cost_items.label: Funds needed before the next step
cost_items.notes: Measure any required upfront amount, confirmed assistance, available funds, waiver outcome, and alternative routes. Do not infer a barrier from a missing payment record.

routes.title: Police-requested emergency protective order

jurisdiction.court: California courts / exact local operation not mapped

routes.first_consequential_decision: Judicial decision on an officer-requested EPO
routes.scope_note: Separate officer-to-judge pathway. The civil DV request cutoff, attachment instructions, and fees are not transferred into this route.

steps.title: Officer prepares the application
steps.description: The official guide identifies EPO-001 as the officer application used in this route.

steps.title: Officer contacts a judge
steps.description: The guide describes a judge available around the clock to review emergency requests. Actual waiting time is not measured.

steps.title: Later protection and review
steps.actor: Participants and court; local sequence not fully mapped
steps.description: The guide describes short duration and a possible later restraining-order request. This selected record has not mapped all response, review, service, or correction channels.

channels.title: Officer-to-judge application
channels.description: The officer-to-judge route is documented. Exact public attachment opportunities and each participant’s earliest response opportunity remain unestablished in this pilot.

review_clocks.label: Published availability: 24 hours a day
review_clocks.description: The statewide guide describes a judge available 24/7 for officer requests. This is an availability statement, not a measured duration or a guaranteed result.

cost_items.label: Participant expenses and upfront barriers
cost_items.notes: No fee schedule, observed expenses, or affordability measurements have been established for this route in the selected sources.

measurement_contract.unit: Defined participant opportunity within a scoped proceeding; specify the unit and observation window before collecting a rate.
measurement_contract.barrier_attribution: Record reported reason, supporting source, review status, and alternatives separately. A funding shortfall alone does not prove causation or that every channel is inaccessible.
measurement_contract.unknown_policy: Missing values are null. Zero requires evidence. Incomplete and unobserved opportunities remain visible in denominators and follow-up.
measurement_contract.privacy_boundary: Public exports contain aggregate or synthetic observations only. No private case intake is provided by this module.
